method: Published CA bundle downloaded and compared byte for byte; the copy installed in the rootfs is verified against the staged source file, and the per-certificate split is regenerated from it by the shipped installer

details.upstream: https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem, downloaded 2026-10-16 and byte-identical to the published file
details.content: 121 certificates, 188900 bytes; Mozilla certdata.txt as of Fri Sep 25 03:12:01 2026 GMT, extracted with mk-ca-bundle.pl 1.33. The bundle header records the SHA-256 of its certdata.txt input (beb7e6df...), which is not the hash of this file
details.install_path: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt, the path curl was compiled with, so https:// works with no --cacert

per_certificate_install.why: mbedTLS parses a PEM file with one allocation as large as the whole file, so the 185 KiB bundle needs one contiguous 185 KiB block, which the no-MMU mmap path cannot always find once the board has been running. The installer splits the same bytes into one file per certificate so every allocation stays at one certificate.
per_certificate_install.derived_from: sdk-src/sources/ca-certificates/cacert.pem; the installer re-splits and checks the file count on every install, so the split is regenerable from the checked bundle

details.license: The NSS certdata.txt metadata is MPL-2.0; the certificate bodies are public data published by each CA. MPL-2.0 text preserved in licenses/ca-certificates/MPL-2.0.txt and installed in the rootfs
details.on_board: Verified on the N32H787 board: https://example.com/ and https://curl.se/ return 200 with verification enabled, a self-signed host is rejected, and the installed file matches the staged source hash
details.refresh: Download https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem again and re-record this file, the version_checks entry in licenses/components.json and sdk-src/sources/ca-certificates/README.md
